name: WidgetSimple
subtitle: Apps as words, see-through
description:
Transparent text widgets for the iPhone Home Screen. Your apps as words, tap one to open it.

Add the source, install WidgetSimple with AltStore, then add the widget from the Home Screen.

apps.name: WidgetSimple
apps.subtitle: Apps as words on a see-through widget
apps.localizedDescription:
Your apps as plain words on the Home Screen, in widgets that are fully transparent — no glass, no frames, no wallpaper screenshots.

• Up to 12 apps per widget, a tap opens the app
• Clock: off, time, time and date, date
• Font, size, colour, case, shadow, spacing
• Stacked layout, or free placement with per-word positions
• Every widget follows the look you set in the app

Requires iOS 27 and a €1/year licence.
